KNOT #1 / leaky-abstraction / fixed
Callers encode and decode stored JSON
DATA FLOW / arrows label what crosses each source boundary; these are not module dependency edges.
See the direct route at the top for the source handoffs.
BEFORE / observed baseline
Orders serializes records to JSON bytes. Reconciliation
decodes those bytes after they pass through history.py's
read_raw_order_history helper and orders.py's
_rows_for_reconciliation facade.
Write an order
JSON bytes
AFTER / fixed
Orders sends records to storage; reconciliation receives
decoded records. Storage owns both JSON operations.
Write an order
Order record
WHY THIS HELPS
Removing the history and order forwarding helpers leaves storage as the sole JSON-format owner. A format change can be handled there
instead of being repeated across callers.
WHAT STAYED THE SAME
For this InMemoryStorage fixture, shared tests check the callable outputs, stored bytes and key order, validation errors, operation
order, pending-order filtering, and reads in both snapshots.
Recorded checks supporting fixed status: tests: pass; build: pass

svg.text: BEFORE / observed baseline
Quote sends the product ID through an order helper and a
storage helper before catalog lookup.
AFTER / fixed
Quote passes the product ID directly to catalog.price_for.
WHY THIS HELPS
The pricing feature no longer crosses order-creation or storage code to read a catalog price.
WHAT STAYED THE SAME
Shared tests check quote output and validation errors, plus order output, exact stored bytes, key order, operation order, and
reconciliation behavior in both snapshots.
Recorded checks supporting fixed status: tests: pass; build: pass
